scPilot is an LLM/API-backed omics-native reasoning and tool-use framework for cell-type annotation, trajectory inference, and GRN prediction, not a trainable representation-learning module or masked-expression objective. The cloned repo requires OPENAI/GOOGLE/OpenRouter-style API keys plus external data downloads and wraps Scanpy/Monocle/SCENIC-style evidence with natural-language reasoning traces. It would change benchmark fairness and cannot be counted as an unsupervised scMAE backbone variant; useful later only as an interpretability or failure-analysis adjunct.

ChatCell is a T5/LLM natural-language interface and supervised instruction-generation system over Cell2Sentence-style gene sequences, with Hugging Face model weights and task-specific instruction data for generation, annotation, and drug-response tasks. It is not an unsupervised masked-expression clustering backbone and would require supervised labels/pretrained LLM weights outside the fair scMAE protocol. Skipped as a primary benchmark variant; potentially useful later for reporting or interactive interpretation.
